description: Run the Physical AI calculator's own 36-month model: manual vs robotic TCO, annual savings, upfront investment, payback month, ROI, coverage, supervision and incidents, plus payback sensitivity to hourly cost, capex, coverage, integration, maintenance and uptime. Every input is optional; use_case applies a published preset first. The response lists the assumptions with their evidence level and the fields_to_validate that are still editorial defaults — tell the user to replace them. Orientative, undiscounted, single currency; not a quote. Use this for the cost, savings or payback of a robot fleet; for an AI-agent business case use calculate_agent_economics.
